Qiyana launches a shockwave that Knocks Back enemies and detonates when it hits terrain. The explosion follows the entire edge of the terrain, Stunning for between 0.5 and [1] seconds and dealing [100 / 200 / 300 + (1.25) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [0.1] max Health physical damage. Any river or brush the shockwave passes through also explode after a delay for the same damage and Stun.
